title: Assemble a pre-norm transformer block
statement:
Step 10 · Transformer block

A pre-norm block applies normalization before each sublayer and preserves a residual path. This deliberately small block uses identity Q/K/V projections and a same-width ReLU feedforward sublayer.

Build it

For each token: u = x + causal_attention(norm(x)); then y = u + ReLU(norm(u)). Q, K, and V are all the normalized token vectors. Return all y vectors. Input is a nonempty matrix of positive width.

Contract: Implement block using Python's standard library. Inputs satisfy the constraints stated here. Do not mutate the inputs. Use the provided helpers where present; they represent earlier steps.

Examples

Input: tokens = [[1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 1]]
Expected: [[2.9999777783259067, -0.9999800005999799], [-0.8883558715100569, 2.8883532775295273], [1.0, 1.0]]
Input: tokens = [[2, -2]]
Expected: [[3.999998194446788, -2.9999987500023435]]
Hint

Compute every attention output from the original normalized sequence before applying the second residual.

Review your understanding

Trace the two residual paths. Which learned projections and parameters would you add to make a full model block?

Explain your reasoning in Notes before opening the worked solution. Passing the local checks completes this exercise; it does not certify production readiness or evaluate your design explanation.
